snippet.title: Windrose - Ashlands Update Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Windrose: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041230/Windrose/

Ashlands is the first major update coming to Windrose, a swashbuckling PvE survival adventure in the Age of Piracy. New biome, new quests, armor and weapons, new challenges, and a new menacing boss to face await! Expected to release this winter. Available on Steam, Epic Games Store, Stove, and Humble Store.

Windrose Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041230/Windrose/
Humble: https://www.humblebundle.com/store/windrose
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/windrose-831c86

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!
